# Vendored theme stylesheet (local preview only)

`design-platform.css` and `gradient-shadow-text.css` are copied from the
installed DeepSeek Harness theme package
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`) so the preview draws with the harness's real
design tokens instead of approximations.

They are here to look at the renderer outside the app and are **not** part of
the published package (`package.json` `files` excludes `preview/`). Do not
redistribute them; copy them again from your own install if you need to.
